hookups.source: ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880207 (11 of 12 Full-Hookup sites list 50-amp with water and sewer; 45 Modern Electric list 50-amp, 110 list 30-amp) + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/laurel-hill-state-park/stay ('Hookups: 149 sites with electric; some full-hookup sites (sewer, water, electricity)'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 261 RV campsites on the booking site (155 Modern Electric, 94 Modern Non-Electric, 12 Full-Hookup) besides cottages, a tent-only site, lodges and group tenting; DCNR's page says 262 sites and 149 with electric. Max vehicle lengths run 15 to 40 ft (mostly 30-35); about 200 sites take 23 ft or more, and there are 7 pull-throughs.
